@Paper.prop_pieces_heavy_few : ∀ {P : ℕ} {T : Paper.Staged P} {giv u : Fin P → ℕ} {M Y k : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    0 < M →
      0 < Y →
        ∑ q, giv q ≤ M → ∑ q, u q ≤ Y → ∀ {s : ℕ}, s < T.depth → {p | T.stage p = s ∧ T.Heavy giv u M Y k p}.card < k
'Paper.prop_pieces_heavy_few' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_pieces_shape : ∀ {P : ℕ} {T : Paper.Staged P} {giv u : Fin P → ℕ} {M Y k : ℕ} (g : ℕ),
  (∃ p, T.piece giv u M Y k p = g) →
    ∃ x,
      (T.Heavy giv u M Y k x ∧ ∀ (p : Fin P), T.piece giv u M Y k p = g ↔ p = x) ∨
        ¬T.Heavy giv u M Y k x ∧ T.Heavy giv u M Y k (T.par x) ∧ ∀ (p : Fin P), T.piece giv u M Y k p = g ↔ T.Below p x
'Paper.prop_pieces_shape' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.Staged.piece_boundary : ∀ {P : ℕ} {T : Paper.Staged P} {giv u : Fin P → ℕ} {M Y k : ℕ} (g : ℕ),
  ∃ x,
    ∀ (q : Fin P), q ≠ T.root → ¬(T.piece giv u M Y k q = g ↔ T.piece giv u M Y k (T.par q) = g) → q = x ∨ T.par q = x
'Paper.Staged.piece_boundary' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_pieces_count : ∀ {P : ℕ} {T : Paper.Staged P} {giv u : Fin P → ℕ} {M Y k b C : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    0 < M →
      0 < Y →
        ∑ q, giv q ≤ M →
          ∑ q, u q ≤ Y →
            (∀ (p : Fin P), p ≠ T.root → {q | q ≠ T.root ∧ T.par q = p}.card ≤ b) →
              {q | q ≠ T.root ∧ T.par q = T.root}.card ≤ C →
                ∀ (p : Fin P), T.piece giv u M Y k p < 1 + C + b * (T.depth * k)
'Paper.prop_pieces_count' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
